thread:
omar: Noticed fncall strict-validate canary (rwd-edge:canary) spiking rejects ~0.2% -> 3.9% at 08:14 UTC. Bringing in eng-platform.
felipe: Any error class or sample? Could be fncall vs toolhook.
yana: Validator logs show "schema_mismatch: expected object, got array". Small responses like ["ok"] frequently. Sample log: ```{
  "route": "/v1/invoke",
  "variant": "rwd-edge:canary",
  "err": "schema_mismatch",
  "expected": "object",
  "actual": "array",
  "resp": ["ok"]
}```
omar: Router currently sends the canary slice to strict-validate. We have a permissive variant but reroutes currently still count against strict buckets.
router-bot: Alert: fncall_validation_rejects > 3% (5m) route=/v1/invoke region=ap-southeast-1 variant=rwd-edge:canary. Suggested quick actions: pause canary, sample fails, or enable soft-accept shim.
felipe: Soft-accept shim would coerce single-element arrays into {"result": value} and let traffic flow so we don't lose signal. Downsides: it masks contract breaks and could let incorrect outputs reach customers.
sre: Revert/pause is safest short-term. Also, if we reroute we need billing reattribution; finance must weigh in.
finance: Current billing maps to original route tag. We can accept a temporary mismatch or add x-rw-route-tag header for reattribution. Header change needs a small billing ingest update and backfill (~48h).
yana: Proposal: 1) Pause canary for safety. 2) Start a 300-sample capture with scrubber and TTL 7d. 3) Console: add a temporary per-slice toggle "suppress-reject-accounting" for internal use (opt-in, auditable) to avoid billing alerts during diagnostic windows. 4) Track longer term: route-tag header and a "soft-accept" feature behind a flag for controlled experiments.
ofar: omar typo: ofar -> omar
omar: ha. Action items: felipe -> pause canary now (5m), yana -> sampling + scrubber (s3://redwood-debug/canary/1768890000/), finance -> draft route-tag spec and opt-in console toggle requirements, sre -> ensure audit logs for any suppressions. I'll create ENG-5510 to track.
felipe: Pausing canary slice now (10% -> 0%). Monitoring.
yana: Sampling started. Scrubber removes emails, tokens, long user content. Writing samples to s3://redwood-debug/canary/1768890000/ with TTL=168h.
router-bot: Monitoring: validation rejects falling to baseline after pause.
finance: Will draft x-rw-route-tag spec and console toggle proposal and attach to ENG-5510. Note: toggle must record user, timestamp, and affected slice id.
sre: We'll only enable suppressions when flagged and with audit log. No automatic suppress.
omar: Thanks team. We'll keep canary paused until model owners confirm output contract stability and we have route-tag plan. Postmortem/next steps on ENG-5510. :thumbsup:
